About The Institution & Fest

Campus Heritage, Excellence & Festival Vision

Est. 2010 • Jaipur

About ANAND-ICE

Anand International College of Engineering was established in 2010. The college provides high quality education in Engineering and Applied Science. It is a perfect place for all the novices to kick start their career with world-class infrastructure, industry partnerships, and visionary faculty.

RTU & AICTE Approved Modern Tech Labs Vibrant Campus Life

About Our Fest

Echona is the flagship annual cultural and technical fest of Anand-ICE Jaipur. It provides a grand platform to all factotum individuals to hone their talents and skills across music, dance, hackathons, robotics, theatre, gaming, fashion runways, and creative design.

Over 2 Days 30+ Competitions Celebrity Star Nights
